segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the ticket number if you have one?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Daniel with Northstar Facilities. Ticket is 184276. I'm looking at invoice 77143 for August, and there's a $420 onboarding support line that shouldn't be there. We finished onboarding back in May.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Let me pull that up in the billing tool. One moment. Okay, I see invoice 77143 dated August 1, total $3,180, and the $420 line you mentioned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right, our normal monthly is $2,760 for 46 seats, so it just jumped out.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, that makes sense. I'm checking the notes in the ticketing system now. It looks like that charge was carried over from an older setup order and wasn't cleared after the May closeout.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We just need the corrected copy before our AP run on Friday, August 9.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can take care of that. I'll remove the line and reissue the invoice today. You should receive the revised PDF by email within about 30 minutes, and the balance will show as $2,760.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Will the invoice number stay the same?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, same invoice number, with a revised timestamp. I'll also add a note on ticket 184276 that the duplicate onboarding line was removed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that's all I needed. Thanks.
